instruction_bn: বাক্যগুলো সঠিক ক্রমে সাজিয়ে একটি অর্থপূর্ণ গল্প/অনুচ্ছেদ তৈরি করো (Board: rearranging)।

sentences: A merchant had a donkey.
One day it was carrying a load of salt.
While crossing a river, it fell down.
Some salt melted and the load became light.
So it began to fall down on purpose every day.
items.rule_bn: কারণ ও ফলের ক্রম অনুসরণ করো।

sentences: Once a king wanted to test his courtiers.
He placed a big stone on the road.
Many people passed by but none removed it.
At last a poor man rolled it aside.
He found a bag of gold under the stone.
A hungry wolf came to a stream to drink.
It saw a lamb drinking lower down.
The wolf wanted to eat the lamb.
It blamed the lamb on false grounds.
At last it killed and ate the poor lamb.
King Bruce was defeated many times.
He hid himself in a cave.
There he saw a spider trying to reach the roof.
It failed again and again but did not give up.
At last it succeeded and Bruce took heart.
items.rule_bn: অনুপ্রেরণার গল্প: হার → লুকানো → পর্যবেক্ষণ → শিক্ষা।

sentences: Once there lived a poor woodcutter.
One day his axe fell into the river.
He began to weep for his only axe.
A fairy appeared and offered a gold axe.
But the honest man took only his own iron axe.
A dog found a piece of meat.
It ran to a lonely place to eat it.
On the way it had to cross a bridge.
It saw its own shadow in the water.
Wanting more, it lost its own piece of meat.
Florence Nightingale was born in 1820.
She was born in a rich family.
She dedicated her life to nursing.
She served the wounded soldiers with care.
She is called the Lady with the Lamp.
Two friends were passing through a forest.
Suddenly a bear appeared before them.
One friend climbed up a tree at once.
The other lay down holding his breath.
The bear took him for dead and went away.
A crow was very thirsty one hot day.
It flew far in search of water.
At last it found a jar with little water.
It dropped pebbles into the jar one by one.
The water rose and the crow drank it.
Sher Shah was a great ruler.
He built the Grand Trunk Road.
The road helped trade and travel.
He also introduced a fair system of rule.
People still remember him for his good works.
A fox once fell into a deep well.
It could not get out anyhow.
A thirsty goat came there.
The clever fox praised the water.
The goat jumped in and the fox escaped on its back.
It was a rainy day.
The sky was covered with dark clouds.
It began to rain heavily.
The roads went under water.
Children enjoyed making paper boats.
Once a lion was caught in a net.
It roared but could not free itself.
A little mouse heard the roar.
It came and cut the net with its teeth.
Thus the mouse saved the mighty lion.
Ismail was a poor farmer.
He had four lazy sons.
Before his death he called them.
He said gold was hidden in the field.
Digging for gold, they got a rich harvest.
items.rule_bn: শিক্ষামূলক গল্প: পরিচয় → উপদেশ → পরিশ্রম → ফল।

sentences: A thirsty pigeon saw a glass of water.
It was really a painting on a board.
The pigeon flew fast towards it.
It struck the board and fell down.
Hasty action brought its ruin.
Bayazid Bostami was a great saint.
One night his mother felt thirsty.
She asked him for a glass of water.
By the time he returned, she was asleep.
He stood all night holding the glass.
A greedy dog got a bone.
It went to a river to eat it alone.
In the water it saw another dog.
It barked to snatch the other bone.
The bone fell into the water and was lost.
The ant is a small insect.
It works hard all day long.
In summer it stores food.
In winter it eats the stored food.
We should learn industry from the ant.
There lived a clever jackal in a forest.
One day it fell into a dyer's tub.
Its body turned blue all over.
The other animals took it for a king.
But one day its howl gave it away.
Isaac Newton was a great scientist.
One day he was sitting under a tree.
An apple fell down on the ground.
He began to think why it fell down.
Thus he discovered the law of gravity.
items.rule_bn: আবিষ্কারের গল্প: পরিচয় → ঘটনা → চিন্তা → ফল।

sentences: A poor boy sold newspapers.
He studied hard at night.
He never lost hope in life.
At last he passed with good marks.
He became a famous man one day.
A farmer had a goose.
It laid a golden egg every day.
The farmer grew greedy day by day.
He killed the goose to get all the eggs.
But he found nothing and lost everything.
Once a hare made fun of a tortoise.
It laughed at the tortoise's slow speed.
The tortoise challenged it to a race.
The proud hare slept on the way.
The slow tortoise won the race at last.
Long ago there was a shepherd boy.
He often cried 'Wolf! Wolf!' for fun.
The villagers came running each time.
One day a real wolf came.
But nobody believed his cry then.
